description: Shared Renovate preset for Templetry repositories. Extend with: github>Templetry/renovate-config

packageRules.description: Non-major updates arrive as one reviewable PR instead of twenty.
Majors arrive alone. In a template repo an upgrade is a product decision: it changes what every generated project starts from.
GitHub Actions move on their own cadence and rarely conflict.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
